decisionsTitle: The shared card is a brand card, drawn from a design object the club will be able to change
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-01:** «poza descărcată pentru Instagram trebuie să fie un pic mai frumoasă, și pe viitor configurabilă» — the picture downloaded for Instagram should be a little prettier, and configurable later.

**What was there.** Since §90 every event has a card drawn on the server from its own facts: the 1200×630 picture Facebook, WhatsApp and every link preview show, and the same card as a square for Instagram, which takes no link. §90 chose facts over a photograph on purpose — an event has no cover picture, and a card that says when and where is what a runner wants from a share. §140 made the square a button called «Instagram», and §299 made that button hand the picture to the phone's own share sheet where it can. The card itself had not changed since §90: a flat diagonal blue, the club's name in spaced capitals behind a small orange bar, a translucent pill with the event's type, the title, «Sâmbătă, 21 nov. 2026 · 10:00» on one line, the place, the distance and the climb with orange dots between them, and the site's address. Correct, and plain: no logo, and nothing told the eye where to look first except the size of the title.

**What changes, in what a person sees** (`events/share-image.tsx`):

- *The club's own logo* at the top left — the white lockup, mountains and «BRASOV RUNNERS», the same file the race numbers carry — instead of the name typed out. The name is therefore the artwork's letters: `CLUB_NAME` is no longer typed onto the card, and a card with the logo switched off carries no name, only the address in the band (§369's criterion is amended to say so).
- *A background with depth*: the same blue diagonal, a soft light at the top right, and one large circle of the kit's orange, faint, half off the bottom-right corner. Nothing busier: no pattern, no stripes, no stock photograph.
- *A hierarchy*: the type pill is a quiet tint of the words' colour with a thin line round it, so that the one solid orange pill on the card is the cancelled one's; the title is larger, at most three lines, under it a short orange rule; then the date with **the time as the headline** — the day in regular weight and the hour large and bold beside it, an orange dot between; the meeting point with a pin; the distance and the climb as two rounded chips, each with a small drawing (a route, a mountain).
- *A white band at the foot* with the site's address in the club's blue and the club's mountains at its right — the site's address is what turns a saved picture back into a visit.
- *Optional, and off by default*: a short line in the club's handwriting face under the title (a tagline), and a photograph behind everything under a blue veil that keeps the words legible.

A cancelled event keeps what it had on the old card, the pill that is solid orange with the word «Anulat» (dark letters on the kit's orange, white on a dark accent the club may choose later) while a scheduled event's pill is only a tint — the colour says it before the word is read, and a test holds the two apart; a date, a time or a place not yet announced says so in the same words as before (§328, §533), and only an announced time becomes the headline.

**The design object, and why it exists before anything stores it** (`events/share-card-design.ts`). «Pe viitor configurabilă» is a promise about later, and the cheapest way to keep it is to make the drawing take every decision from one place now. `ShareCardDesign` holds them: the look (`brand` — the blue, the default; `ink` — near-black with a blue glow; `paper` — the page's off-white with dark words and a blue band), the accent colour (the kit's orange), whether the logo, the type, the place, the route and the address are drawn, the tagline (at most 60 characters) and the background picture (an absolute `https:` address, or none). `readShareCardDesign` reads anything — an old row, a typo, garbage — as a design, field by field, and never throws: a card that fails to draw is worse than a plain card, the reasoning of the race number's design (§249). Every element that can be switched off leaves no gap behind it. Today nothing stores the object and every caller passes the platform's defaults. **The next step, named and not built:** a `share_card_design` JSON column on `events`, read through `readShareCardDesign`, and a box in the event editor beside the race number's — exactly the pair `bib_design` is (§249) — when the club asks for it. When that box offers a picture, it should offer the pictures this site stored, as the bibs do, rather than any address.

**What Satori decided.** `next/og` draws through Satori, which lays out with flexbox only, wants every element with children set to `display: flex`, and draws every line of text it is given. So the title is cut by its length — past 110 characters, at the last whole word, with «…» (`clampTitle`) — and its size is chosen from its length (`shareTitleSize`: the largest step at which it fits three lines of the card's width, at half an em for a lower-case letter and 0.65 for a capital or a wide one (an all-capitals title is not drawn four lines high), measured on rendered cards rather than guessed; on the wide card a title keeps to two lines from 56 pixels up). The logo and the mountains are handed over as data, read once per process (and named in `outputFileTracingIncludes` for the two routes, so the build ships them); a background picture is fetched on each render, behind the route's hour-long cache, at an `https:` address only, without following a redirect, with a five-second deadline and a four-megabyte ceiling checked on the announced length and again while the body is read, and anything that fails draws the card without it. The chips say «circa 10 km» and «350 m diferență de nivel», the long forms the picture always used (§585, §598), not the pill's «≈ 10 km»: the bundled Roboto has no «≈», and a missing letter makes Satori download a font from Google in the middle of drawing. The handwriting face (Caveat, already in the repository for the signed declaration) is loaded only for a card that has a tagline (and if the file cannot be read the tagline is drawn in Roboto), because Satori parses every font it is handed and the file is six times Roboto's.

The site's own card (`[locale]/opengraph-image.tsx`) shares no code with the event's and is unchanged.

**Tests.** `tests/unit/events/share-card-design.test.ts` — the defaults, garbage read as the defaults, a bad accent read as the orange, a `javascript:`, `http:` or `data:` picture read as none, each palette accepted, the tagline cut at its ceiling, the colours of each palette and of a picture, the pill letters on a light and a dark accent, the title's clamp. `tests/unit/events/share-image.test.ts` — the real `next/og` drawing both shapes to a PNG whose header says 1080×1080 and 1200×630, with every element switched off, for a cancelled event and for a date and place to be announced, over a background picture, in the ink and paper looks and with a tagline, and the title's size never growing with its length. The existing tests of the picture's words (§328, §349) pass unchanged.

*Rejected:* a photograph picked automatically from the event's description — which picture represents an event is the organizer's choice, and it is what the future setting is for. A third shape for stories (1080×1920) — not asked; the design object can carry a shape later. Fetching a picture from the gallery at render time — a network call inside a cached image route, and the club has not chosen a picture to fetch. Any new font or library — the card uses the Roboto and the Caveat already in the repository and `next/og`, already installed.
changelogLine: - **A prettier card to share** — the picture «Instagram» downloads and the one links show carry the club's logo, a deeper blue with the kit orange, the time as the headline, the route as chips and a white band with the site's address; its design is one object with the platform's defaults, ready to be made the club's choice later. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 8. Given a published event, when its card is drawn in either shape, then it is drawn from one design object with platform defaults (palette, accent, which elements show, an optional tagline and background picture) that nothing stores yet; by default it carries the club's logo, the type pill as a quiet tint (a cancelled event's pill is the solid accent, so the two differ in colour as well as in word), the title (at most three lines, cut at a word with «…» past 110 characters), the date with the time as the headline, the meeting point with a pin, the distance and the climb as chips, and a paper band with the site's host; a switched-off element leaves no gap, and a card with a background picture keeps its words legible under an overlay (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 11. The share pictures carry the club's name as the lockup's artwork, drawn from `LOGO` in `@/theme/brand`; `CLUB_NAME` is not typed onto them, and a card whose logo is switched off names the club only through the host in its band (2026-10-01, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a prettier shared card, drawn from a design object
